summary: Google Play Console Subscription and In-App Product IDs using underscores (e.g. 1_pro_monthly, 2_pro_annual, 1_tip_5) with $9.99 monthly and $69.99 yearly pricing. PlayBillingManager queries both underscore and hyphenated aliases for 100% compatibility, with automated purchase acknowledgment, tip consumption, and Firestore sync. Zero UI buttons added.
